title: The landing's visual world is a flat volleyball court plan in three layers
decision: The page ground is the free zone (teal) and content sits on the court (coral). White 5 cm court lines are the only dividers. L0 court: rules and ground; radius 0, no shadow, never interactive, lines never rounded. L1 objects: app surfaces on --card with shadow, never outlined, radius concentric (inner = outer - padding). L2 floating chrome: only the header and the footer theme switcher; transparent at rest, the app nav's glass once scrolled. Type floors: body and description text at least 14px (text-sm); any text set on the court or the free zone at least 16px (text-base); text-xs only for badges, meta labels and Beta. Global tokens are only --court and --court-foreground; every other court token is scoped to the landing.

alternatives.reason: Superseded by the court plan as the landing's visual world.
Says nothing about volleyball or the product.
The recording screen already uses the flat court colours, and texture or gradient conflicts with the flat product UI.

consequences: Landing colour tokens do not leak into the app.
A future DESIGN.md migration records these rules.
